channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Entrevista ao g1 e à GloboNews: Caiado descarta privatizar BB e Caixa e propõe ajuste fiscal e revisão da reforma tributária
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), presidential candidate, advocates for fiscal adjustment through public spending cuts and a revision of the tax reform to reduce bureaucracy. He proposes privatizing Correios and segments of Petrobras, particularly in natural gas exploration, but rules out privatizing Banco do Brasil and Caixa Econômica Federal due to their role in serving disadvantaged regions. Caiado cited his experience in Goiás, where he implemented administrative reforms, cut fiscal incentives by over R$3 billion, and reformed the state pension system.

item.title: TSE determina bloqueio das contas de Fábio Faria, ex-ministro de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ordered the blocking of accounts belonging to former minister Fábio Faria due to non-payment of a fine imposed for publishing content against Lula (PT) during the 2022 electoral campaign. The measure aims to enforce the sanction issued by electoral justice. The blockade remains in effect while Faria awaits a final ruling on the case.

item.title: O fogo amigo do PT no caso Marcola e a bomba para Lula nas investigações sobre Lulinha
item.description: The Marcola case, involving Lula’s former chief of staff, has created internal strain within the PT after it was revealed he received R$ 249,000 from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, close to Lulinha. While Marcola claims the money was a personal loan, suspicions suggest it was intended to benefit Lulinha’s interests in government. The leak is described as 'friendly fire' from within the PT, reflecting internal tensions over his growing influence in Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Ex-BBB Matteus se declara branco ao TSE após polêmica com cota racial
item.description: Former BBB contestant Matteus Amaral declared himself white to the TSE following controversy over alleged racial quota fraud for admission to IFFAR in 2014. He claims the enrollment was made by third parties without his knowledge and regrets any impression of improper benefit. Matteus is running for federal deputy in 2026 under the Progressistas party.

item.title: “O PT tem sido conivente com o avanço do narcotráfico”, diz Caiado
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado accused the Workers' Party (PT) of being complicit in the advance of drug trafficking in Brazil, citing insecurity in Rio de Janeiro’s streets as evidence. The statement was made during a GloboNews and g1 sabatina on Friday, February 7. Caiado implied that the PT’s inaction enables organized crime to grow.

item.title: Candidata a deputada, Val Marchiori declara R$ 49 milhões em bens
item.description: Val Marchiori, a socialite and former model known for appearing on the reality show 'Rich Women,' officially registered her candidacy for federal deputy from São Paulo in the 2026 elections and declared assets exceeding R$ 49 million to the TSE. Her declared assets include a house valued at R$ 48 million, R$ 800,000 in jewelry and artworks, plus bank deposits and a 50% stake in company shares. This is her first time running for elected office.

item.title: O caos e a preocupação nos bastidores da escolha do nome para vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The last-minute selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate replaced the expected choice of Rogério Marinho, forming a pure PL ticket that excluded women and Centrão party leaders. Gaspar's inclusion raised immediate concerns due to unresolved allegations of sexual abuse of a minor, which he denies, and the campaign's failure to conduct proper vetting. While Gaspar may serve as a political asset due to his role in investigating pension fraud, his controversial background now poses a significant liability.

item.title: Entrevista ao g1 e à GloboNews: Caiado propõe criar polícia conjunta com países sul-americanos para combater o crime organizado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) proposed the creation of a joint police force with ten South American countries to combat international organized crime, modeled after Europol’s cross-border policing framework. He also advocated deploying the Brazilian Armed Forces (Army, Navy, and Air Force) to reoccupy territories controlled by criminal factions, stating their role is not to arrest but to resolve territorial occupation.

item.title: Caiado anuncia Roberto Azevêdo para seu plano de governo
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced Roberto Azevêdo, former WTO Director-General, to lead diplomacy and foreign trade in his government plan. Azevêdo, a career diplomat and the first Latin American to head the WTO, had already contributed to the program prior to the announcement. Caiado criticized political polarization and the federal government for damaging Brazil’s international relations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lança Valadares e Coronel Rocha ao Senado por Sergipe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced the PL party's support for the candidacies of Rodrigo Valadares and Coronel Rocha for the Federal Senate in Sergipe during the 2026 elections. The announcement was made during a live broadcast, reinforcing the party's strategy to consolidate alliances in the state. This move strengthens the Bolsonarist base in Sergipe for the majoritarian race.

item.title: Boulos diz que vice de Flávio é 'casamento perfeito da rachadinha com orçamento secreto'
item.description: The Secretary-General of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos, stated that the selection of federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) ticket represents a 'perfect marriage' between suspicions of 'rachadinha' and irregularities in the Legislative Branch budget.

item.title: Lei aumenta penas para violência sexual digital contra crianças e adolescentes e endurece punições
item.description: Law 15.487/26 increases penalties for digital sexual violence against children and adolescents, including offenses involving AI, deepfakes, and fake profiles. The law classifies these crimes as heinous, authorizes virtual patrols for investigation, and enhances victim protection, replacing the term 'child pornography' with 'sexual violence against children or adolescents'.

item.title: Caiado promete anistia a golpistas do 8 de janeiro, reformas e polícia transnacional com 10 países
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado promised amnesty for those involved in the January 8, 2023 attacks as a way to pacify Brazil, stating the issue would leave the agenda after approval. He also said he would send a package of reforms on his first day in office, including administrative, political, tax, and Social Security revisions, plus an anti-terrorism law. Caiado avoided labeling the January 8 events as a coup attempt, comparing the situation to the annulment of Lula’s convictions.

item.title: nova lei prorroga linha de crédito para Santas Casas e hospitais filantrópicos
item.description: Law 15.486/26 extends until 2030 the deadline for applying FGTS funds to credit operations for philanthropic hospitals, Santa Casas, and nonprofit institutions serving people with disabilities and complementing the SUS. The law also clarifies the application of a tax rule from Complementary Law 187/21, extending its interpretation to tax credits not yet definitively established, even if arising from events prior to the law's enactment. Originating from Bill 2465/26 by Deputy Paulo Pimenta (PT-RS), it was signed by President Lula and published in the Official Gazette on March 7.

item.title: Federação de Lula aciona TSE contra o PL de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT-PCdoB and PV) has filed a complaint with the TSE against the PL over alleged irregular use of the Party Fund to finance the 'Direita Já' website, which produces and distributes disinformation targeting Lula and his allies, including deepfakes and false accusations of ties to organized crime. The federation claims the site functions as a parallel coordination network for mass content distribution, with over 1,600 publications in 2026 reaching more than 50 million users, evading electoral transparency, labeling, and accountability rules.

item.title: Emenda Pix de vice de Flávio entra na mira da PF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to investigate a 'Pix amendment' by Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (União-AL), who is the pre-candidate for vice-president on a ticket led by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The decision stems from a TCU audit report raising suspicions of irregularities in the allocation of public funds through parliamentary amendments. The measure places the deputy and his electoral alliance under investigation for potential misappropriation of public money.

item.title: Entrevista ao g1 e à GloboNews: Caiado promete anistiar condenados por 8 de janeiro: 'Briga inútil que só traz desgastes'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential candidate, announced he would pardon those convicted for the January 8, 2023, golpe attempts if elected, stating the measure aims to pacify the country and end a 'useless fight' that only causes wear. He compared the debate over January 8 to Lula’s release, arguing both issues must be overcome to advance productive and developmental agendas. Caiado also said he would send administrative, political, and tax reform proposals to Congress on his first day in office.

item.title: Após reunião com sindicatos, Boulos diz que governo descarta mudar PEC da redução da jornada e pressiona Senado por votação
item.description: The Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos, stated that the government will not negotiate changes to the PEC reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours and is pressuring Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to bring the proposal to a vote in the CCJ and plenary. He rejected extending the transition period, saying one year is already the maximum acceptable limit, and warned that the opposition could exploit the delay electorally if the vote does not occur before the 2026 elections.

item.title: Crusoé: Um vice do PL Homem
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) officially nominated Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as the vice-presidential candidate on the Liberal Party's ticket for the 2026 elections. Gaspar, rapporteur of the INSS CPMI and former Senate pre-candidate from Alagoas, was chosen for representing courage in fighting corruption, organized crime, and defending conservative values. The move reinforces the PL's strategy of uniting Bolsonarist leaders in a ticket strongly aligned with the legacy of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Redistribuição de urnas garante mais eficiência nos locais de votação
item.description: The Electoral Justice is redistributing 563,910 electronic voting machines across federal units to keep pace with electorate growth and the increase in polling sections for the 2026 General Elections. Coordinated by the TSE and the 27 TREs, the initiative aims to improve logistical efficiency and ensure equipment availability where most needed, optimizing the voting machine park and voter experience.

item.title: Renan Santos fará 1º ato de campanha em frente a prédio da USP
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, announced his first campaign event for August 16 in front of the USP Law School at Largo São Francisco, where he studied but did not graduate. The event aims to gather around 2,000 people and use the building's parlatory for his campaign launch speech, emphasizing his personal connection to the institution and its democratic symbolism.

item.title: Data-limite para apresentar pedidos de registros de candidaturas termina dia 15
item.description: The deadline to submit candidacy registration requests for the 2026 elections ends at 7 p.m. on August 15. Applications must be filed exclusively through the Candidacy System (CANDex), the updated web version integrated with Electoral Justice systems. Granting of registration depends on judicial review by the TSE and is not guaranteed by mere submission of the request.

item.title: Caixa leva a leilão apartamento de Eduardo Bolsonaro no Rio
item.description: Caixa Econômica Federal repossessed an apartment owned by Eduardo Bolsonaro in Rio de Janeiro's South Zone after he defaulted on mortgage payments. The property, valued at over R$1 million, will be auctioned on August 20 with an opening bid of approximately R$644,300. The loss followed failed delivery of notifications and edict service, amid judicial asset freezes tied to STF investigations.

item.title: Crusoé: Os políticos que lideram as vaquinhas nesta eleição
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) regulated collective campaign financing in 2017, allowing donations of up to 10% of gross income per CPF, with anonymous donations prohibited, rules in effect since 2018. In that year's election, Jair Bolsonaro and João Amoêdo were highlighted as leaders in crowdfunding campaigns (vaquinhas). The O Antagonista article analyzes how these financing mechanisms are being used by politicians in the current election.

item.title: TSE cria conselho de especialistas para assessorar Nunes Marques sobre IA
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques established an expert advisory council to guide the Court on electoral information integrity for the 2026 elections, focusing on AI misuse, disinformation, and digital content manipulation. The council replaces the 2017 Internet and Elections Advisory Council and will include specialists from technology, public security, media, health, and other sectors, meeting monthly on a voluntary basis starting in August.

item.title: Gilmar não aceitará pedido de vice de Flávio para acelerar exame de DNA em ação sobre estupro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes rejected a request by Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro, to expedite a DNA test within 72 hours in a rape investigation. Gaspar's defense claims the existing DNA evidence refutes the allegations and urges immediate closure of the case due to lack of proof. The Federal Police continues preliminary diligences, with the investigation centered on the alleged rape, not paternity.

item.title: Patrimônio de Romeu Zema cresce R$ 49,1 milhões em 4 anos
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential candidate, declared R$ 178.8 million in assets to electoral justice, an increase of R$ 49.1 million (38%) since 2022. This growth exceeded the 19% inflation over the same period and is mainly due to a family holding (R$ 94 million) and investment fund applications (R$ 56.2 million). His running mate, Eduardo Girão, declared R$ 34.1 million, while Samara Martins (UP) is the only other registered candidate with R$ 33,000.

item.title: Lula se reuniu com integrantes do Republicanos e Podemos antes de partidos negarem aliança com Flávio
item.description: Lula separately met with Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos) and national Podemos president Renata Abreu on Monday, before the parties announced national neutrality in the 2026 elections. The meetings occurred as Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to secure alliances with both parties, unsuccessfully. The parties' neutrality decision was seen as a strategic win for the government, although Motta's allies say the gesture also aimed to secure future support for his 2027 Chamber re-election bid.

item.title: No DF, Rebeca Andrade fatura maior nota do mundo no salto em 2026
item.description: Rebeca Andrade achieved the world's highest score on vault in 2026 with a 14.800 at the Brazilian Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Brasília. The Olympic champion returned to competition after a mental health hiatus, executing a Yurchenko with double twist of difficulty five. Despite the historic score, she did not advance to the vault final due to completing only one attempt, choosing to focus on the team event.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quer revogar imposto de 12% sobre petróleo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed repealing the 12% export tax on crude oil, arguing it harms national production and likening it to Argentine policies that caused shortages and price hikes. He stated that, if elected, his government would aim to reduce taxes to stimulate economic activity, including reforming the 2027 tax overhaul, which he criticized for excessive exemptions that could push the VAT among the highest globally.

item.title: Lei permite usar recursos de emendas para atendimento pré-hospitalar realizado por bombeiros
item.description: Law Complementary 234/26, signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, allows parliamentary health amendments to fund pre-hospital care provided by firefighters. The law prohibits using these funds for salaries of active or inactive military firefighters or for non-emergency-related expenses. It recognizes firefighters as first responders in life-threatening situations.

item.title: Dino manda PF investigar emendas Pix do vice de Flávio citadas por TCU
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino referred a TCU report to the Federal Police indicating irregularities in Pix amendments authored by deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 election. The report flags R$ 6.2 million in three amendments to São José da Laje (AL) due to untraceable fund transfers and missing management reports in Transferegov. The TCU audit, covering 2020-2024, identified over R$ 55 million in damages to the public purse.

item.title: O patrimônio humilde de Erika Hilton
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSOL), running for re-election in 2026, declared to the Electoral Justice R$ 15,975.73 in assets, as recorded in the TSE portal. Her wealth consists of a checking account at Caixa Econômica Federal and three fixed-income investments at Nubank. The article emphasizes the modesty of her assets compared to other politicians.

item.title: 8/1: STF contraria Moraes e abre precedente para descontar medidas cautelares das penas de réus
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruled, by six votes to four, to establish a precedent allowing precautionary measures applied to defendants in the January 8 acts to be deducted from their final sentences. The decision contradicts the earlier stance of Justice Alexandre de Moraes and may reduce prison time for those convicted of anti-democratic acts. The ruling sets a new parameter for penal execution in cases related to the January 8 events.

item.title: Caixa reúne entidades esportivas, cobra cumprimento dos contratos e mantém suspenso patrocínio à CBAt
item.description: Caixa Econômica Federal convened sports entities to demand strict compliance with sponsorship contracts after discovering that ex-athletes from the CBAt-sponsored Ídolos do Atletismo program posted social media content praising politicians Jair Bolsonaro, Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas while tagging the bank. The bank suspended sponsorship to CBAt and requested explanations, viewing the posts as potential breaches of institutional advertising rules using public funds during an election period.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro declara apoio à esposa de JHC ao Senado por Alagoas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared support for Marina Candia, wife of pre-candidate JHC, for the Senate in Alagoas, despite her being confirmed as a federal deputy candidate by the PSDB. The endorsement came after the PL nominated Alfredo Gaspar as its vice-presidential candidate, freeing up the Senate slot for Marina. The coalition between PSDB, PL, PDT and other parties remains undefined, with the second Senate seat expected to go to Arthur Lira (PP).

item.title: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam Ronaldo Caiado, candidato à Presidência pelo PSD
item.description: Goiás Governor Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's presidential candidate, will be interviewed by g1 and GloboNews on Monday at 2 p.m. in a live, simultaneous broadcast by journalists Andréia Sadi and Natuza Nery. He is the third candidate to be interviewed in the series, following Renan Santos and Romeu Zema, while Lula declined the invitation and Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet responded. The interview is part of an invitation extended to the five top candidates in the July 24 Datafolha poll.

item.title: TSE cria conselho para monitorar IA e desinformação nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has established the Advisory Council on Informational Integrity for the 2026 Elections to monitor risks linked to artificial intelligence and disinformation, aiming to safeguard the legitimacy and normal functioning of the electoral process. The body will advise the Court's presidency on informational integrity measures.

item.title: Os desencontros da chapa presidencial bolsonarista
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto and Flávio Bolsonaro disagree on when Alfredo Gaspar was chosen as vice-presidential candidate, with Flávio stating the idea came at the last minute. Flávio said he preferred Daniella Marques as his running mate but is satisfied with Gaspar, leaving open the possibility of Gaspar returning to the Senate race. The PL party’s internal resolution in Alagoas confirms Gaspar could run for Senate if he steps down from the vice-presidential ticket.

item.title: PF vai convocar ex-chefe de gabinete de Lula para depor sobre repasses de lobista
item.description: The Federal Police has summoned former Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (known as Marcola), to testify in two investigations before the Supreme Federal Court (STF) involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and Flávio Luís Lula da Silva, the president's eldest son. The inquiries concern alleged irregular payments linked to lobbying activities. The article is available exclusively to subscribers.

item.title: Zema propõe prisão preventiva de ‘criminoso contumaz’
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential candidate for 2026, proposed in his government plan that individuals detained three times should be subject to preventive detention. The measure primarily targets low-level offenses such as theft and robbery, aiming to reduce recidivism through stricter enforcement of pre-trial detention.

item.title: O que motivou Dino a mandar PF investigar novas irregularidades em emendas
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the Federal Police to investigate potential crimes linked to irregularities in individual amendments (Pix amendments), following a TCU report identifying R$ 55 million in losses across 100 amendments. The irregularities included lack of transparency, unverified payments, and overbilling, indicating persistent unconstitutionality in the execution of these funds.

item.title: Toffoli nega pedido que permitiria candidatura de desafeto de Moro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Dias Toffoli rejected a petition by former state deputy Tony Garcia to annul a civil non-prosecution agreement that bars him from running for public office for eight years, stemming from Operation Rádio Patrulha. Garcia argued the decision should be extended by analogy to the annulment of cases against former governor Beto Richa, but Toffoli denied the request, stating the legal grounds do not automatically apply. Even if successful, Garcia would not be guaranteed candidacy, as his party, the Christian Democracy, has opted to support Sergio Moro in the Paraná gubernatorial race.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: O vice problemático de Flávio e os humildes bens de Erika Hilton
item.description: The Meio-Dia em Brasília program discusses Flávio Bolsonaro’s vice-presidential pick, highlighting controversies around the choice, while also covering Erika Hilton’s modest asset declaration and Romeu Zema’s government plan. It further examines the PT’s criticism of Alfredo Gaspar and other relevant political news.

item.title: Casa JOTA reúne campanhas presidenciais para debater agenda digital
item.description: Casa JOTA in Brasília will host representatives from the main presidential campaigns on Wednesday, August 12, at 9 a.m., in an event sponsored by Brasscom. The goal is to hear each candidate's priorities regarding Brazil's digital development, based on the 'Digital Agenda: Proposals for the 2027-2030 Cycle' document prepared by Brasscom. The event will be livestreamed on JOTA's YouTube channel and fully covered across all JOTA platforms.

item.title: O que a PGR disse a Moraes sobre a foto de Daniel Silveira com senador
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) submitted an opinion to the STF advocating that Daniel Silveira remain in open regime, but with new 'guidelines' to prevent social media access, following a video in which he supported Senator Carlos Portinho's re-election bid. The PGR views the incident as isolated and emphasizes the rehabilitative purpose of penal execution, warning that future violations will not be tolerated. Minister Alexandre de Moraes will decide Silveira's fate, as the opinion is non-binding.

item.title: TSE cria órgão para monitorar fake news e uso indevido de IA nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has established the Advisory Council on Informational Integrity to monitor false content and the improper use of artificial intelligence in the 2026 elections. Composed of unpaid experts in technology, public security, and communications, the council will advise TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, propose partnerships, and promote digital literacy. Meetings will be held at least monthly until December.

item.title: Erika Hilton declara ter patrimônio 20% menor que em 2022
item.description: Federal deputy Erika Hilton (PSOL) declared assets of R$15,975.73 to the TSE in 2026, 20.08% lower than the R$19,989.96 declared in 2022. The majority of her current assets are held in a Caixa Econômica Federal checking account (R$13,602.14), followed by fixed-income investments (Nubank, Tesouro Direto, and RDB). She is the first Black transgender woman to lead a congressional bench in Brazil and is running for re-election in São Paulo.

item.title: João Campos tem patrimônio quase oito vezes maior que Raquel Lyra
item.description: The national president of the PSB and former mayor of Recife, João Campos, declared a net worth of R$2.8 million to electoral authorities — nearly eight times that of Governor Raquel Lyra, according to filings with the TSE. This wealth disparity has become a notable point of comparison in the 2026 Pernambuco gubernatorial race, sparking discussion on candidate transparency and economic inequality.

item.title: Em plano de governo, Zema propõe privatizar Petrobras e freio ao STF
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) proposed in his government plan the privatization of all state-owned enterprises, including Petrobras and public banks, reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16 years, limiting the power of the STF with a minimum age of 60 for justices and ending senators' privileged jurisdiction, alongside labor flexibilization and state reduction. The program also includes PPPs in health and education, visa exemptions for tourists from safe countries, and regulation of homeschooling.
